title: wedelia urticifolia var. wallichii
intro: Wedelia urticifolia var. wallichii, commonly known as Wallich's Wedelia, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family known for its medicinal properties. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Wallich's Wedelia include pain relief, wound healing, and the reduction of inflammation, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
